definitions.gloss: gari; pickled ginger (the kind served with sushi)
definitions.explanation: Thin slices of young ginger pickled in sweetened vinegar, pale pink to white in color. Served alongside sushi as a palate cleanser between pieces. Originally sushi-restaurant jargon (gyoukai-yougo) that has entered general use.

examples.japanese: ガリ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ひと{切|き}れ{口|くち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れた→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: I put a piece of pickled ginger in my mouth.

examples.japanese: ⟦{寿司|すし}→寿司：04946_sushi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ガリ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{緑茶|りょくちゃ}→緑茶：10971_ryokucha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{付|つ}いてくる→付いてくる：29670_tsuitekuru⟧。
examples.english: The sushi comes with pickled ginger and green tea.

examples.japanese: ⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ネタ→ネタ：06309_neta⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、ガリ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{口直|くちなお}し→口直し：29907_kuchinaoshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{通|つう}→〜通：04025_tsuu⟧な⟦{食|た}べ{方|かた}→食べ方：27437_tabekata⟧だ。
examples.english: Cleansing the palate with pickled ginger before the next piece is the connoisseur's way to eat sushi.

notes:
Originally sushi-restaurant slang ({業界用語|ぎょうかいようご}). The name is said to come from the gari-gari sound made when chewing or slicing the firm ginger. The standard term is ⟦{甘酢|あまず}→甘酢：14851_amazu⟧⟦{生姜|しょうが}→生姜：05191_shouga⟧ ("sweet-vinegar ginger"), but ガリ is far more common in everyday use.

FUNCTIONS:
Gari is a palate cleanser eaten between pieces of sushi to refresh the mouth, not a topping to be placed on the sushi itself.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ガリ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つまむ→つまむ：10374_tsumamu⟧: to nibble on pickled ginger
- ガリ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧: to eat pickled ginger
- ガリ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{口直|くちなお}し→口直し：29907_kuchinaoshi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to cleanse the palate with gari
- お⟦{代|か}わり→代わり：01296_kawari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ガリ: a refill of pickled ginger

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{紅|べに}→紅：13862_beni⟧しょうが: red pickled ginger — bright red, finely cut; topping for ⟦{牛丼|ぎゅうどん}→牛丼：08600_gyuudon⟧, ⟦{焼|や}きそば→焼きそば：13405_yakisoba⟧, etc.; different style and use
- {新生姜|しんしょうが}: young ginger — the raw ingredient ガリ is made from
